headerDisplay: Companion plugin for [petkit-bridge](https://github.com/raulhartzen/petkit-bridge). Run the bridge first, then point this plugin at it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of this platform instance, shown in the Homebridge UI and logs.

bridgeUrl.title: Bridge URL
bridgeUrl.description: Base URL of your petkit-bridge instance.

token.title: Bridge token
token.description: The BRIDGE_TOKEN value you set when deploying petkit-bridge (however you provided its configuration).

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh fountain state and litter maintenance status.

feedAmount.title: Feed amount
feedAmount.description: Amount dispensed by the Feed switch. Model-specific: e.g. the d4h (Yumshare) accepts 10, 20, 30, 40 or 50. If invalid, the plugin retries once with the smallest value the bridge reports.

scoopWait.title: Scoop cycle duration (seconds)
scoopWait.description: How long the bridge waits before ending a cleaning (scoop) cycle. Leave empty to use the bridge default (~50s, tuned on the Puramax 2).

feedName.title: Feed switch name
feedName.description: Display name of the feeder switch — this is what the Home app shows and what Siri responds to (e.g. 'Eroga cibo'). Leave empty for 'Feed'.

cleanName.title: Clean switch name
cleanName.description: Display name of the litter cleaning switch (e.g. 'Pulisci lettiera'). Leave empty for 'Clean'.

maintenanceName.title: Maintenance switch name
maintenanceName.description: Display name of the litter maintenance switch (e.g. 'Manutenzione'). Leave empty for 'Maintenance'.

enableFeedAll.title: Enable "Feed All" switch
enableFeedAll.description: Adds a single switch that dispenses on ALL feeders at once. Only created when at least two feeders are discovered.

feedAllName.title: Feed All switch name
feedAllName.description: Display name of the Feed All switch — what the Home app shows and Siri responds to (e.g. 'Eroga cibo'). Leave empty for 'Feed All'.

enablePetSensors.title: Pet activity sensors
enablePetSensors.description: Creates a Motion Sensor per pet (named after your pets in the PetKit app): it fires when that pet uses the litter box — great for Home app notifications and automations. Not intrusive: sensors live in the status row, not among controls.

enableMealSensors.title: Meal sensors on feeders
enableMealSensors.description: Adds a Motion Sensor to each camera feeder that fires when an eating session is detected.

mealSensorName.title: Meal sensor name
mealSensorName.description: Display name of the meal sensor (e.g. 'Pasto'). Leave empty for 'Meal'.

motionResetSeconds.title: Sensor reset (seconds)
motionResetSeconds.description: How long an activity/meal sensor stays triggered before clearing.

enableCameras.title: Native HomeKit cameras (experimental)
enableCameras.description: Exposes camera-equipped devices as HomeKit cameras. Requires: a running go2rtc instance (URL below) and ffmpeg installed on the Homebridge host. Streams are auto-registered on go2rtc; each camera pairs individually in the Home app.

go2rtcUrl.title: go2rtc URL
go2rtcUrl.description: Base URL of the go2rtc API. RTSP is assumed on the same host, port 8554.

cameraVcodec.title: Camera video codec
cameraVcodec.description: ffmpeg video codec. 'copy' (default) passes the H.264 stream through — lowest latency/CPU. Set 'libx264' to transcode if your device's stream misbehaves in Home.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Path to the ffmpeg binary, if not on PATH.
